## Pull request overview

This PR implements Phase A of the Airtable Interface parity roadmap, introducing a self-contained, shareable, multi-page application surface distinct from the existing AppSchema navigation container. The Interface concept enables role-specific surfaces that stitch together views, elements, and actions into cohesive experiences.

**Changes:**
- Introduces `InterfaceSchema` with 12 page types (dashboard, grid, list, gallery, kanban, calendar, timeline, form, record_detail, record_review, overview, blank)
- Adds `RecordReviewConfigSchema` for sequential record review/approval workflows with configurable actions and navigation modes
- Extracts shared `SortItemSchema` to `shared/enums.zod.ts` for reuse across UI schemas
- Implements per-element data binding via `ElementDataSourceSchema` enabling multi-object pages where each element can query different data sources
- Adds four content element types (`element:text`, `element:number`, `element:image`, `element:divider`) with corresponding prop schemas

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/ui/interface.zod.ts | New file defining InterfaceSchema, InterfacePageSchema, RecordReviewConfigSchema, and InterfaceBrandingSchema with comprehensive documentation and examples |
| packages/spec/src/ui/interface.test.ts | Comprehensive test suite with 57 tests covering all schemas, validation rules, edge cases, and end-to-end scenarios |
| packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts | Adds ElementDataSourceSchema for per-element data binding and extends PageComponentType enum with four content element types |
| packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts | Adds ElementTextPropsSchema, ElementNumberPropsSchema, and ElementImagePropsSchema with corresponding ComponentPropsMap entries |
| packages/spec/src/ui/index.ts | Exports the new interface.zod.ts module |
| packages/spec/src/shared/enums.zod.ts | Extracts reusable SortItemSchema pattern (field + order) from inline definitions |
| packages/spec/src/shared/enums.test.ts | Adds comprehensive tests for SortItemSchema validation |
</details>

The defineInterface factory function follows the same pattern as defineView, defineApp, defineFlow, and defineAgent, which are all exported from the root index.ts for developer convenience. However, defineInterface is not exported there. For consistency with the established pattern, consider adding:

```typescript
export { defineInterface } from './ui/interface.zod';
```

to packages/spec/src/index.ts around line 80, near the other DX Helper Functions.
Added in 0e35543 — `defineInterface` is now exported from root `index.ts` alongside `defineView`, `defineApp`, `defineFlow`, and `defineAgent`.
